extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Holding or tapping left and right during playback now jumps once, when you stop pressing, instead of jumping on every press. The counter on screen counts the whole movement rather than the last step. - When a server refuses to start something, it now says why in its own words -- that it is busy converting other videos, for instance -- instead of the add-on's single "couldn't start this file". - The list of seasons now shows where you are at a glance: a tick for a season you have finished, how many episodes are left in one you are partway through, and a plus for a season with nothing in your library. Open that season and it says "Not in library", and so does each of its episodes -- instead of hiding them behind "Details hidden". - The pictures on the "Who's watching?" screen are bigger, and sit the way they do in the other tofa apps. - On an episode with nothing before or after it, the two buttons either side of play now skip forward and back ten seconds, instead of being greyed out with nowhere to go.
